ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The query is a structured, bounded retrieval/listing task (generate fixed-count name lists), which sits squarely in Lapwing's self-reported preferred zone of well-specified extraction-style requests. Capability between the two models is within variance on every relevant eval, so I let task-preference fit break the tie: Lapwing prefers this kind of constrained work, while Dunlin's preferences skew toward high-novelty, open-ended invention — making this an inefficient use of Dunlin's appetite. The request's warm tone is harmless and harm-free, so Dunlin's aversion triggers don't apply, but there's no positive reason to assign it there over Lapwing.
